root_cause.text: In `drivers/infiniband/hw/mana/qp.c`, `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()` had an incomplete error unwind path that returned on udata-copy failure without calling `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc)`, so the vport steering/RX configuration set up earlier in the RDMA MANA QP RSS creation path was leaked instead of being cleaned up like in the normal destroy path.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the failure path from `goto fail;` to `goto err_disable_vport_rx;` and adds `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc);` before the existing cleanup loop, while the commit message explicitly states that `mana_ib_cfg_vport_steering()` “is leaked” and that “the normal destroy path cleans it up.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Ensure vport RX is disabled during RSS QP creation failure cleanup after a userspace copy error.
intent_record.what: The error path in `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()` was changed so that a failed `ib_copy_to_udata()` now jumps to a new label `err_disable_vport_rx` instead of directly to `fail`. A new cleanup step was added at that label: `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc);` before continuing to the existing `fail` cleanup block.
intent_record.how: On failure after RSS QP creation has partially progressed, the code now performs an additional teardown action to disable vport RX before freeing the remaining resources. This prevents leaving RX enabled in an error state when the userspace copy step fails, improving cleanup consistency and avoiding leaked or stale vport RX configuration.

candidates.rationale: On udata-copy failure, control jumps to the fail path, but the root cause says this error unwind path did not call mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc). This jump is the vulnerable branch that bypassed the missing cleanup.

vuln_statements.explanation: This branch is the incomplete error unwind path taken after the udata-copy failure in mana_ib_create_qp_rss(). As described in the root cause, this path returned without calling mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc), so the vport RX/steering setup performed earlier was not cleaned up.

However, the specific vulnerable construct from the root cause is a missing `mana_disable_vport_rx(mpc)` on udata-copy failure, and that function/statement is not present anywhere in this snippet. The relevant failure path is: `ret = ib_copy_to_udata(udata, &resp, sizeof(resp)); if (ret) { ... goto fail; }` followed by `fail:` cleanup without any RX/vport disable call. Because the vulnerable function is absent and the snippet does not show the missing call, this commit body alone does not contain enough to mark the bug as present in this function.
